summary: @servicetitan/widget-platform-monolith preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/...`, unpacks it, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a bundled `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` compiled bundle containing a shuffled string-array (`WV8StW`), a large opcode/dictionary table (`n7gIxM`), and a runtime string/identifier decoder (`hc1jfK9`); its behavior is not resolvable statically and the payload is deliberately invoked through an alternate runtime rather than Node. The package's advertised library surface (`dist/index.js`) is a thin `export * from "@servicetitan/widget-platform"` plus three local re-exports on top of a same-named dependency, providing no functional reason to publish other than to carry the preinstall dropper. The name mimics ServiceTitan's internal `@servicetitan` scope while the published version chain traces to unrelated user forks, consistent with a typosquat/hijack lure rather than a legitimate ServiceTitan release.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
